metadata.content:
'archType': 'Dual Comparison',
 'visualTags': [
 'Minimalism',
 'Texture Macro',
 'Split-screen',
 'Cinematic Lighting',
 'Stable Shot'
 ],
 'parameters': {
 'angle': 'Frontal Eye-Level',
 'lighting': 'Professional Studio with Moving Light Sweep',
 'layout': 'Vertical Split (50/50)',
 'subject_specs': 'Left: Product Unit (Unboxed); Right: Texture/Material Macro',
 'bg_color': 'Abstract Solid Color (Matching Product Tone)',
 'action': 'Left: Subtle Rotation; Right: Slow Dolly Zoom'
 }
 },
 'description': 'A high-end commercial vertical split-screen composition. The frame is divided into two distinct sections. On the LEFT side, the actual product unit (bottle, jar, or device) stands upright without packaging. On the RIGHT side, the intrinsic quality of the product is displayed—either a raw smear of the texture (for liquids/creams) or a high-definition macro close-up of the surface material (for solids/tech). The background is a clean, abstract solid color that matches the product's tone to maintain focus. A soft light sweep moves across both objects to reveal texture depth. The Left side product rotates very slightly (approx 15 degrees) while the Right side camera slowly zooms in (dolly forward) to emphasize the material quality.'
